scope: Saved rows 0 and 1 only; append separately for future rows without rechecking completed indices. No model integration, fitting, source edits, commit or PR.

lineage.producer: Frozen installed native solver and project scorer at source revision above
lineage.checker: New standalone standard-library/NumPy script; no zhenmode imports or project scoring calls
shared_layers: The same declared linear analytic reference and metric definition
lineage.contamination: Candidate and reported pilot metrics already exist and have been inspected; this is an independent implementation of a post-production raw audit, not an untouched qualification oracle. No fit or threshold change is authorized.
lineage.claim_limit: Identity/data integrity and independent arithmetic readback only; no new held-out physical accuracy certification, arbitrary-precision identity closure, global SOTA or full physics qualification

controls.positive: Independently constructed constant and linear-in-time arrays pass exact inventory and known trapezoidal RMS checks, also after NPZ serialization
controls.negative: Nonzero perturbation must fail exact comparison; changed contract digest and file byte must fail hash checks; incorrect capacity field must fail geometric capacity check
controls.null: Zero errors have exact zero RMS; identical trajectories have exact zero difference
controls.metric_agreement: abs(actual-stored) <= 5e-15 + 5e-12*abs(stored), except inventory roundoff uses abs difference <= 2e-14; tolerance fixed before the first raw-array audit; original thresholds remain unchanged

timing.projection: unknown; bounded single raw-array audit measures its own elapsed time
timing.progress_unit: Completed audited index written to append-only row ledger
timing.route: Read saved compact arrays and metadata; no toolkit algebra or integration backend is needed
